Supplementary group membership is fixed at process start: the shared queue daemon is pid 1645, started 15:20:07Z, BEFORE the docker-group grant, and /proc/1645/status reads Groups: 4 24 27 30 105 1000 -- no 113 -- so every process it launches inherits a credential set without the docker group and a bare docker call in it fails with permission denied. The wrap is contained to this probe's own driver, alters no gate, threshold, cap, label or registered reading, and is launch plumbing, not a measurement path.

amended_completion_clause: The struck clause required the literal string 'Min Quality', which occurs ZERO times in any pyHyp log (amendment A1.2). Implemented instead, per A1.3: (a) SANITY -- a line containing '| Min     | Min     |' immediately followed by a line containing '| Quality | Volume  |'; (b) THE INSTRUMENT -- the POSITIONAL read of table column 9. The two are not interchangeable. pyHyp REPRINTS the whole header block mid-table (measured: 2 stacked pairs in the vcoarse log), and data rows are distinguished by NOT beginning with '#' (A1.5). Completion requires 92 data rows at levels 2..93 contiguous, rc=0, a non-empty grid, and a Grid Ratio header line; a run failing any clause is reported INCOMPLETE and its readings are not used (prereg 4.1).
cap_behaviour: STRUCTURAL, not by intention: pyHyp is invoked serially under `timeout 900s`, so 1 rank x 900 s / 60 = 15.0 core-min is the worst the launcher can spend. A timeout kills the probe, the result is reported incomplete under prereg 4.1, and THE CAP IS NOT RAISED -- a re-run at a larger cap would be a new registration (prereg 9.2).
readings_registered: 1: Min Quality (column 9) at EVERY level 2..93 -- minimum, its level index, and the full column retained; Min Volume (column 10) read alongside as the second instrument. 2: march closure -- (a) the header Grid Ratio and (b) THE AUTHORITATIVE last-level March Distance (column 12), closure meaning 0.120E+02 at the printed precision. 3: achieved first-cell height = the level-2 March Distance; the requested s0 is an INPUT and is NEVER reported as a measurement (MESH_STANDARD.md 9.2:528-538). 4: pyHyp serial CPU time (column 2, last level) for the docs/COST_CALIBRATION.md row required by rule 12, and for no other purpose. THERE IS NO FIFTH READING and nothing else the log prints may be promoted into one after the fact.
